Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/ripoff-sound.nets.

MAME's two hacks here are value changes and both are undone by their switches: the motor-1 and beep voltage triggers use the sheet's 4.7K (MAME's hack is 100 ohms), and the resistances into the CA3080s IC12 and IC6 are the sheet's, not five times them.

Compared with the sheet, Schematic Audio Board - Rip Off SD207201 Rev A (doc 3a2cac26e2cb p80, native 300 dpi), with the assembly drawing AE207201 Rev A (p79) and the parts list PL207201 (pp58-60), 2026-10-20: the input buffers IC25 (J4-11/12/13), the shift register IC8 and latch IC9 with R24; the background DAC (IC10, R23, D1, R25-R30, IC19, R76), both background VCOs (IC20, IC21, C30, C31, R77-R82, D6-D11), the level translator Q10 (R83-R85) and the counter IC22 with R86-R91 and C32; the laser and torpedo channels (R56, R66, C26-C29, D2-D5, IC16, IC17, R57-R61, R67-R71, Q8, Q9, and IC18 with R62-R65 and R72-R75 into R47, R48 and C21); the explosion (IC1 S2688, R1-R10, C1-C8, IC2, the one-shot IC4, Q1, IC3), beep (IC5, R11-R18, R20-R22, C9-C11, Q2, Q3, IC6) and motor 1 (IC11, IC13, R31-R44, C14-C19, Q4, Q5, IC12) channels; and the summing node (R19, D12/D13, the follower IC7, C12, R45, R49) all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value, diode and transistor orientation included. The values MAME's hacks change are the sheet's: R11 and R40 are 4.7K, R18 is 820K and R36 is 1M on the schematic, the assembly drawing and in the parts list's counts. IC18's taps are not binary-ordered (QC takes the smallest resistor); the sheet draws both halves that way and MAME follows it. MAME differs only at the final-amplifier boundary: R45 and R49 go into IC14 pin 2 and only IC14 pin 3 is grounded (MAME line 679 grounds both inputs of IC14 and IC15); corrected above.

The jumpers W1-W8 are taken as fitted, as MAME takes them; R50 is drawn dashed and noted optional, and C13 and C20 are not used (note 6). Not in this file: the final amplifier and regulators (R46, IC15, Q6, Q7, IC23, IC24), which are on the sheet. MAME's comment calls Q6 (2N6292) a PNP; it is an NPN, and the sheet draws it as one.
conflicts: The parts list gives one 1N5240 where both drawings have three (D1, D12, D13, and note 3 names all three), and three 470-ohm and eight 1K resistors where both drawings have two and nine; the totals agree and the list names no positions. This file follows the drawings.
IC4's reset (pin 4) is not drawn; MAME ties it to +5V ("not documented in schematics"), the only way the one-shot works.
